title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 36: the mountains of Israel made fruitful again, and the promise of a new heart and a new spirit.

questions.text: To whom is the son of man told to prophesy at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The son of man is told to prophesy to the mountains of Israel and to call them to hear Yahweh's word.

questions.text: What had the enemy said about the ancient high places?
questions.explanation: The enemy said "Aha!" and claimed that the ancient high places were theirs in possession.

answers.text: That they should all be torn down
That they were under a curse
That they were theirs in possession

questions.text: Besides the residue of the nations, against whom has Yahweh spoken in the fire of his jealousy?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has spoken against the residue of the nations and against all Edom, who appointed his land to themselves for a possession.

questions.text: What will the mountains of Israel do for Yahweh's people?
questions.explanation: The mountains of Israel will shoot out their branches and yield their fruit to his people Israel.

answers.text: Shoot out branches and yield fruit

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise to multiply on the mountains of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will multiply man and animal on them, and they will increase and be fruitful.

questions.text: What did the house of Israel do to their land while they lived in it?
questions.explanation: When the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds.

answers.text: They defiled it by their ways and deeds
They divided it fairly by lot

questions.text: For whose sake does Yahweh say he is acting, and not for Israel's sake?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he does not do this for the sake of the house of Israel, but for his holy name, which they had profaned among the nations.

answers.text: For the kings of the nations
For the sake of the land's fruit
For the sake of the prophets

questions.text: What will Yahweh sprinkle on them to make them clean?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will sprinkle clean water on them, and they will be clean from all their filthiness and from all their idols.

questions.text: What will Yahweh take away out of their flesh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh promises a new heart and a new spirit, and says he will take away the stony heart out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh.

questions.text: What will people say the land that was desolate has become like?
questions.explanation: They will say that this land which was desolate has become like the garden of Eden, and that the ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.

answers.text: Like the islands of the sea
